glosses: należący do panny, będący jej własnością
Of or pertaining to a maiden.
Suitable for, or befitting a maiden; gentle; modest; pure; shy.

examples.text: “I’ll try, but it was a very ungentlemanly thing to do, I didn’t think you could be so sly and malicious, Laurie,” replied Meg, trying to hide her maidenly confusion under a gravely reproachful air.

glosses: A girl or an unmarried young woman; maiden.
A female servant or cleaner (short for maidservant).

examples.text: She was a fat, round little woman, richly apparelled in velvet and lace, […]; and the way she laughed, cackling like a hen, the way she talked to the waiters and the maid,[…]—all these unexpected phenomena impelled one to hysterical mirth, and made one class her with such immortally ludicrous types as Ally Sloper, the Widow Twankey, or Miss Moucher.

glosses: A virgin, now female but originally one of either gender.

examples.text: You are betrothed both to a maid and man.
W latach panieńskich chodziłam z ojcem na spacery nad Olzę.
